Additionally, the evidence describes a section titled 'Learning Raydrop & Alignment' which explains that to make generated points closer to real ones, they 'learn a raydrop processing on the generated dense points' to account for signal loss (points dropped due to reflectance/angle), rather than assuming perfect reflection.
